itemListElement.name: Hindi Transcription in India: Free and Paid Ways to Turn Audio Into Text in 2026

mainEntity.name: How can I transcribe Hindi audio to text for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Google Docs voice typing with Hindi selected, YouTube auto-captions for videos, or the free plan of an AI transcription tool. One catch with YouTube: auto-captions are published automatically once ready, so upload as unlisted or private if the audio is confidential.

Yes. Google Docs voice typing lists Hindi, YouTube's auto-captions cover Hindi, and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text accepts hi-IN as a paid API. One gap worth knowing: YouTube live-stream auto-captions are English only, so a Hindi webinar gets captions only after the stream becomes a video.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Hindi transcription and translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcription writes spoken Hindi as Hindi text. Translation converts it into another language, such as English, while transliteration writes Hindi words in Roman script. Many people searching for English to Hindi transcription actually need translation or transliteration, so pick the right one before choosing a tool.

Some tools can. Lynkk has a Hinglish setting for meetings where speakers switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence. YouTube, by contrast, lists overlapping speech and multiple languages among the reasons it generates no captions at all. Test a real 10 to 20 minute Hinglish meeting first.

mainEntity.name: Which app is best for Hindi transcription of meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI meeting assistant that supports Hindi is the most practical choice, because it also summarises and lists action items. Lynkk, for example, handles Hindi and Hinglish on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and in person. Model processing can be pinned to India at workspace level.

Yes, with clean input. AI Hindi transcription is accurate for clear audio with 1 speaker at a time.
